basic_info.description: A rare opportunity in San Francisco's coveted Portola District, this custom semi-detached four-bedroom, two-bath home offers 2,180 sq. ft. of living space on a desirable corner lot. Lovingly owned by the same family for over 60 years, 548 Burrows St. blends classic San Francisco charm with outstanding potential.    The light-filled main level features a spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining room, three generous bedrooms, a full bath, and a large eat-in kitchen. The lower level expands the possibilities with a fourth bedroom, full bath, and a spacious entertainment room complete with wet bar and  private street entranceideal for guests, extended family, or flexible use.    A huge garage accommodates parking, storage, and laundry, with direct access to a low-maintenance patio perfect for outdoor enjoyment.    Situated just steps from the shops, cafs, and restaurants of San Bruno Avenue, and close to parks, playgrounds, and McLaren Park, this home offers a unique blend of city convenience and neighborhood tranquility. Quick access to public transportation and HWY 101/280 makes commuting a breeze.    Whether you're searching for a move-in-ready residence, an investment property, or a renovation project, this Portola classic is a true gem ready to be reimagined.
